item.title: [−3] Tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz as drone raises alarm at Iraq gas field
item.description:
Signal: shipping chokepoint disruption. 23 reports from Supply Chain Management Review, شبكة تواصل الإخبارية, The National and 20 more. Related: “Houthis parade captured US weapons after seizing key global shipping strait with Saudi-backed forces retreating”. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 10 Nov).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: strong headwind (−3) — Freight, insurance and fuel costs rise

Why it matters: India imports most of its crude and much of its LNG through Hormuz and the Red Sea; disruption lifts oil, freight and insurance costs, widening the import bill and pressuring the rupee.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −3, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+3] Canadian Dollar loses ground to US Dollar as oil prices decline amid Fed rate hike bets
item.description:
Signal: lower oil prices. 6 reports from Reuters, The Times of India, www.tmgm.com and 3 more. Related: “Indian shares edge higher on easing oil prices despite Asia slide”. Mixed: 3 reports point the other way. Ongoing: also reported on 5 of the previous 7 days (first 10 Nov).

Aviation, shipping & logistics: strong tailwind (+3) — Jet fuel costs fall

Why it matters: Cheaper crude shrinks India's import bill, supports the rupee, eases inflation and lifts margins for fuel marketers, airlines and crude-linked manufacturers.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance +3, Inflation outlook +1, Rupee +1, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] Rupee flies high in Asia on easing crude oil prices, foreign flows
item.description:
Signal: a stronger rupee. 6 reports from FXStreet, Devdiscourse, Free Press Journal and 2 more. Related: “Indian Rupee strengthens on lower oil prices, AI unwinding”. Turn: earlier readings (14 Nov) pointed the other way.

Aviation, shipping & logistics: mild tailwind (+1) — Dollar costs ease

Why it matters: A stronger rupee lowers import costs and inflation but trims IT and pharma exporters' rupee earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee +3, Inflation outlook +1, Foreign investor flows +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
